Global Outlets Report on Academic Misconduct and Student Well-being

Multiple international outlets are reporting on distinct events concerning academic integrity and student welfare. In China, the National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC) has launched its largest-ever academic misconduct investigation following scrutiny of research by a high-profile blogger. Four academics have been officially investigated after losing their university posts. Meanwhile, Japan has initiated a student suicide watch as the new school term begins. Separately, France is commencing the school year with a new survey focused on sexual violence.
